notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23282681/df4db16457d4df448882143f6a0813aacb18bb81.jpg
(artist: Everybery)

Happy Holidays from Hanako Games! We hope that the new year will bring us all opportunities and better times than what has come before.

2024... it sounds very futuristic, doesn't it? We hope to have some new release information available later this year, so stay tuned for updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23282681/41d41f26ef31e257f58769fa95ee8ae2cc5e353a.jpg

Remember that you can get this and other yuri-focused Hanako Games titles together at a discount in the Yuri Games Bundle, now with extra boost until Jan 4th:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

notes.title: Discount + Yuri Bundle Update
notes.content:
A LIttle Lily Princess is on discount this week:

And along with it, we've added a new yuri-only game to our bundle offer:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

Purchase together for additional savings on yuri-themed products!

notes.title: Our Biggest Discount + Yuri Bundle Update
notes.content:
This week, for the first time, A Little Lily Princess is 75% off on Steam! If you've been on the fence before, now is the best time to pick it up.

We also have special bundle offers for buying yuri-themed games together at an extra discount, and today have added a new entry to that bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1085/Hanako_Yuri_Bundle/

Purchase together with A Little Lily Princess for extra savings!

notes.title: Minor stability update (Jan 2017)
notes.content:
This update contains a small change to achievement handling to fix a rare bug. More information available on the discussion forums:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/449250/discussions/0/143388511228558655/

Please go there for any questions or to report any problems.
